title: The Last Province
logline: A Syrian refugee and a Roman legionary's diary cross 1,900 years of the same border.
plot: In 117 AD, a young auxiliary soldier from the eastern provinces is posted to guard the frontier of a Roman Empire that will never grant him citizenship; he keeps a diary of the families he is ordered to turn back. In 2017, a Syrian architecture student fleeing Aleppo finds a copy of that diary in a museum in Thessaloniki while waiting months for asylum papers. The film cuts between the two, as one man marches with a legion through the ruins of Palmyra and the other crosses the same mountains on foot with his younger sister. Both are caught between an empire that needs them and a state that will not admit them, and both must decide what they owe the people they meet on the road.

title: Thin Air
logline: A Nepalese village's first Winter Olympics team trains on a glacier, until the glacier tries to kill them.
plot: A washed-up Olympic coach recruits four misfits from a Nepalese mountain village to form the country's first ski-mountaineering team for the Winter Games. Mocked by the federation and broke, they train on an unmapped glacier above their village. When an avalanche cuts them off from the valley a month before the qualifying race, the team is stranded at altitude with a broken radio, one injured teammate and dwindling food. Surviving the mountain becomes their real training: they ration supplies, build a snow shelter, and climb out by the hardest route on the face. Weeks later, frostbitten and unranked, they arrive at the qualifier, where nobody believes what they did to get there.

title: Gold Standard
logline: Ten days of the Olympics, one earthquake, and a gymnast who has to choose between a medal and a city.
plot: On the night of her final at the Summer Olympics, a seventeen-year-old gymnast is warming up when a magnitude 8 earthquake strikes the host city. The arena half collapses, the athletes' village is cut off and the opening of a fault line threatens the stadium where eighty thousand spectators are trapped. Her coach wants her evacuated; her rival, a sprinter from the opposing team, refuses to leave his family in the stands. As aftershocks roll through the city and the organizers argue over whether the Games can go on, the athletes use their strength, speed and discipline to lead a rescue through the wreckage, while the world watches the broadcast feed that never stopped running.

title: Second Unit
logline: A film crew shooting a tsunami movie on a real coastline gets a real tsunami.
plot: A fading Hollywood director stakes everything on an old-fashioned disaster epic, shot practically on a remote island off the coast of Indonesia. The production is a mess: the star walks off, the budget is gone, and the studio sends an accountant to shut it down. On the last day of the shoot, as the crew rigs a giant wave machine for the climax, an undersea earthquake triggers a real tsunami warning. With the town's sirens broken, the crew turns their lights, cranes, generators and rescue boats, all built to fake a catastrophe, into the only working emergency system on the island. The director gets the shot of his life, and has to decide whether to keep filming.

title: Injury Time
logline: A lower-league striker deep in gambling debt is ordered to throw the biggest match of his life.
plot: A gifted but reckless striker for a struggling third-division English football club hides a secret from his teammates: he owes a fortune to an underground poker game run by a charming, dangerous bookmaker. When the team makes an impossible run to the FA Cup final against a Premier League giant, the bookmaker offers to clear his debt if he misses a penalty and fixes the result. As the final approaches, he counts cards, bluffs his coach and plays one last high-stakes game to win his way out, while his sister, the team's physio, and an old teammate who once took a bribe try to pull him back. In the final minutes at Wembley, he has to decide what kind of player he is.

title: The Summer Dig
logline: A sulky 14-year-old is shipped off to her grandmother's archaeological dig, and finds a lost tomb and herself.
plot: After her parents' divorce, fourteen-year-old Nadia is sent to spend the summer with her estranged grandmother, a famous archaeologist searching the Jordanian desert for a lost Nabataean tomb. Bored and angry at first, Nadia finds a carved stone the adults dismiss, and with two local teenagers follows its clues through ancient ruins, hidden passages and booby-trapped chambers, racing a gang of treasure hunters who want the tomb's gold. Along the way she has her first crush, learns to trust her new friends and finally understands her grandmother, who chose adventure over family. By the end of the summer Nadia has found a lost treasure, and a sense of who she is.

title: Season Finale
logline: A reality-show castaway discovers the producers have gone home and the island is real.
plot: A charming, camera-hungry contestant on a hit survival reality show plays every trick to win the million-dollar prize on a tropical island. He fakes injuries, invents alliances and stages confessionals for the hidden cameras. When a storm hits, the production quietly evacuates the crew, but a network executive decides that a contestant who doesn't know he's alone makes for a better finale. For weeks he keeps performing for cameras that are no longer recording, until his rations run out and he has to learn to survive for real. Meanwhile his secret broadcast becomes a global ratings phenomenon, and the audience must decide whether to keep watching or demand his rescue.

title: The Heretic Princess
logline: A princess with magic powers is put on trial by her own kingdom's church.
plot: A devout young princess prays every night to a God who answers in an unexpected way: one morning she wakes up able to work miracles, healing the sick and making the dead flowers in the castle garden bloom. The kingdom's church declares her gifts the work of the devil, and her father, the king, must allow a heresy trial. Locked in a convent awaiting judgment, she befriends a doubting young priest who has lost his faith, and together they search the scriptures for an answer: is it magic, or is it grace? With a chorus of talking animals, an exasperated guardian angel and a kingdom of frightened believers, the princess must prove that faith and wonder are the same thing.
